title: PCR Prep from cDNA for IVT Reactions
author: Allen Institute for Brain Science
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bgm9ju96
materials: PCR Prep from cDNA for IVT Reactions
Qiagen Taq PCR Master Mix (Qiagen 201445) at 4ºC.
Millipore 96well vacuum manifold and vacuum pump with regulator and trap
Purified ds PCR2 product ready for IVT reaction.
Allow 1.5 hr for 384-well plates to thaw.
Allow 1.0 hr for 96-well plates to thaw.
Using BioRad (Thermo) or MJ Thermalcycler, run the PCR through the following cycles:
Using BioRad (Thermo) or MJ Thermalcycler, run the PCR through the following cycles making sure that the blocks are at 95C before inserting plates (hot start protocol):
Store left-over Taq PCR Master Mix reagents at 4ºC.

steps.title: Pre-Reaction Preparation
steps.instruction: Prepare reagents and materials 24 hours before the planned PCR reaction.

substeps.instruction: Ensure sufficient Taq PCR Master Mix (1.7 ml bottles) is available at 4ºC; thaw overnight from -20ºC if necessary. Do not use master mix stored at 4ºC for longer than 1 month.
Transfer 10 µM primer plates (Forward, Reverse, and Nested) from -20ºC to 4ºC.
On the day of reaction, transfer glycerol stock plates from -80ºC to room temperature (RT).

steps.title: PCR1 Reaction Setup
steps.instruction: Assemble the first PCR reaction for 192 reactions (2x96) using a 96-well PCR plate.

substeps.instruction: Label the 96-well PCR plate as 'PCR_YYMMDD_PP'.
Remove primer plates from 4ºC to RT to thaw.
Prepare a cDNA/nuclease-free water premix (adjust volumes for sample count with 10% overage), vortex for 5 seconds, and store in a bench-top cooler.
Vortex Taq Master Mix for 5 seconds and spin down.
Aliquot 25 µl of Taq Master Mix into the PCR plates using an electronic 8-channel p200 repeater with filter tips.
Aliquot 20 µl of cDNA premix into the plates using an electronic 8-channel p200 repeater with filter tips.
Spin down primer plates, then add 2.5 µl of 10 µM each Forward and Reverse primers (or 5 µl of 10 µM combined FOR/REV primers) using a 12-channel p10 with filter tips.
Spin down the PCR plates.

steps.title: PCR1 Thermal Cycling and Analysis
steps.instruction: Run the PCR1 thermal cycler and verify product quality.

substeps.instruction: Cycle the reactions: 95ºC for 30", 62ºC for 30", and 72ºC for 90" for 35 cycles.
Return leftover Taq PCR Master Mix (marked with date and 'X') and primer plates to 4ºC.
After cycling (approx. 2.5 hours), spin down the plates.
Perform a spot check of 12 samples (6 per plate) using the Bioanalyzer (per MB0004).
Seal plates with a plate mat; store at 4ºC if PCR2 is within 24 hours, otherwise store at -20ºC.

steps.title: PCR2 Reaction Setup
steps.instruction: Assemble the second PCR reaction using PCR1 products as templates.

substeps.instruction: Prepare template: Dilute 1 µl of PCR1 into 99 µl nuclease-free water, or 3.0 µl of PCR1 RA (1:10) into 27 µl nuclease-free water.
Vortex Taq PCR Master Mix for 5 seconds and spin down.
Aliquot 25 µl of Taq PCR Master Mix to plates using an electronic 8-channel p200 with filter tips.
Aliquot 19 µl nuclease-free water to PCR plates using an electronic 8-channel p200 with filter tips.
Aliquot 1 µl of 1:100 PCR1 template using a 12-channel p10 with filter tips.
Spin down primer plates, then add 2.5 µl of 10 µM each Forward and Nested primers (or 5 µl of 10 µM combined FOR/NEST primers) using a 12-channel p10 with filter tips.
Spin down the PCR plates.

steps.title: PCR2 Thermal Cycling and Analysis
steps.instruction: Run the PCR2 thermal cycler and verify product quality.

substeps.instruction: Cycle the reactions: 95ºC for 30", 64ºC for 30", and 72ºC for 90" for 35 cycles.
Return leftover Taq PCR Master Mix (marked with date and 'X') and primer plates to 4ºC.
After cycling (approx. 2.5 hours), spin down the plates.
Perform a spot check of 12 samples (6 per plate) using the Bioanalyzer (per MB0004).

steps.title: Clean-up and Purification
steps.instruction: Purify PCR products using Montage-96 filter plates to remove primers.

substeps.instruction: Label Montage-96 filter plate and seal unused wells with aluminum tape.

Add 55 µl of nuclease-free water to a row in the filter plate, mix up and down twice, and transfer the total 105 µl (including sample) to the filter plate. Repeat for each row, changing tips between rows.
Place the plate on the vacuum manifold, turn on vacuum, and verify pressure reaches 20-22" mm Hg.
Vacuum for 5 minutes. Shut off vacuum and allow the plate to release on its own.
Blot the underside of the plate with a folded Kimwipe.
Add 50 µl of 10 mM Tris pH 8.0 to each row using a 12-channel p200, changing tips between rows.
Incubate the plate with the lid on at RT for 30 minutes for resuspension.
Recover 45-50 µl of sample from filters into a labeled V-bottom 96 plate using a 12-channel p200, pipetting up and down twice to mix before recovery. Change tips between rows.

steps.title: Quantification and Quality Control
steps.instruction: Perform UV quantification and Bioanalyzer analysis on purified samples.

substeps.instruction: Prepare Bioanalyzer (BA) 1:2 dilution: Add 4.0 µl nuclease-free water to BA plate using an 8-channel p200 repeater.
Transfer 4.0 µl of PCR sample to both UV and BA plates using a 12-channel p10.
Prepare UV 1:25 dilution: Add 96 µl nuclease-free water to the UV plate using a 12-channel p200, changing tips between rows.
Seal PCR2 and BA plates and store at -20ºC.
Seal UV plates with aluminum tape, spin down, and read on SpectraMax M2 using the appropriate 'DNA_bkgd_constant' assay. Store UV plates at 4ºC.
Thaw BA plate for 3 minutes, spin down, and run on Bioanalyzer (per MB0004).
If sample concentrations are between 50-100 ng/µl, move primer plates to -20ºC.
